eligibility_reason: The complete ten-video source scope and published segmentation/trace summaries are identified, and all ten manual-ROI files are authenticated, but original movie/frame transformations, trace/native assembly equivalence and reproduction criteria remain unresolved.

source_paper.title: An end-to-end recurrent compressed sensing method to denoise, detect and demix calcium imaging data

evidence.locator: Results: Evaluating DeepCaImX on experimental datasets; Figure 3; Methods: evaluation; Extended Data Figure 7
evidence.supports: Original ten-video Allen experimental benchmark reports mean F1 0.847, SD 0.037, with strict IoU>0.5 and shared-ROI trace evaluation.

evidence.locator: Full versus mini model; training data and experimental preprocessing
evidence.supports: Full model uses synthetic NAOMi training, mini demo uses FISSA, and experimental inputs are normalized to [0,1]; mini examples are not the paper’s experimental panel.

evidence.locator: Manually Labelled ROIs/ABO paths; Demo (full-version); preprocessing notebook
evidence.supports: Pinned file metadata identifies the ten manual-ROI recordings and source frame labels 18501–23500; array contents were not read.
Zenodo record archives the software; it must not be misidentified as the Allen source movie archive.

evidence.locator: RECORDINGS, FRAME_LABELS, match_iou, _aggregate and evaluate holds
evidence.supports: Current evaluator scores assembled masks/traces, emits macro-recording F1 and retains native assembly, authentic references and source-equivalence holds.

evidence.locator: OphysExperiment specimen.donor.id, imaging_depth and targeted_structure for exact ten IDs
evidence.supports: Official metadata identifies eight unique donors across ten videos; two pairs share donors and four videos are outside VISp. Preserve the original ten-video endpoint but account for donor clustering.

Actual 7,316,832-byte released full checkpoint has Keras 2.9.0 graph with 400×64×64 input, 8 output neurons and valid temporal kernels 3,3,1 implying 396 trace samples under the released demo temporal convention; native output shapes were not verified. Its source identity is authenticated; equivalence to paper N=15/P=9 is unresolved.

target.description: Denoise, detect and demix neurons in the original ten experimental Allen two-photon videos. Primary ordered comparison is original manual-ROI segmentation F1; extracted trace accuracy and runtime remain separately reported source endpoints, not substituted for segmentation.

dataset.description: Allen Brain Observatory motion-corrected experimental recordings, with pinned author manual-ROI files for frames 18501–23500. Zenodo 12650420 is the software archive, not the movie dataset. Exact movie/frame-to-reference transformation receipts remain unqualified.

cohort.description: All ten original GCaMP6f recordings at depths 175, 275, 375, 550 and 625 micrometres: 501271265, 501704220, 524691284, 531006860, 603516552, 604145810, 607040613, 669233895, 671162628 and 679353932. Official Allen metadata maps them to eight distinct donors: 603516552/604145810 share 593402240 and 669233895/671162628 share 657195961. Four videos are outside VISp, conflicting with the paper ten-mice/primary-visual wording. Preserve every original recording, depth and annotated frame label; do not invent replacement mice or regions.

split.description: Use the source full model trained on NAOMi synthetic data and evaluated on the fixed ten-video experimental panel; mini FISSA demo data are not substitutes. The final ten-video panel must remain the same, and candidate development access/exposure must be declared rather than inventing a new mouse split.

inputs.description: Original motion-corrected movie clips, each 488×488×5000, and permitted training data/model conditions. Manual ROI masks and imaging-derived reference traces are scoring labels, not model inputs during final evaluation.

preprocessing.description: Source normalizes inputs to [0,1] and paper tiles 64×64×400 with 11-pixel spatial overlap. Physical movies are 512×512; original 488×488 crop origin and raw frame-label index base remain unresolved. Released full checkpoint uses 8 output neurons and 396 trace samples versus paper N=15/P=9; its actual bytes are authenticated but native/paper equivalence is not. Released trace preprocessing subtracts spatial Gaussian then bilateral filters, whereas paper describes bilateral filtering, temporal lowpass subtraction and overlap correction.

metric.description: Match each manual reference ROI to the highest-overlap predicted ROI with strict IoU>0.5. F1=2TP/(Npred+Nref). For trace correlation use the reference ROIs detected by every compared method; those imaging-derived traces do not measure electrical ground truth. Ambiguous many-reference matching requires source resolution.

aggregation.description: Paper segmentation summary is arithmetic mean F1 across all ten videos, with SD across videos; baseline 0.847±0.037. Pooled ROI-count F1 is a different statistic and cannot replace the source macro-video score.

full_panel.description: All ten original Allen recordings 501271265, 501704220, 524691284, 531006860, 603516552, 604145810, 607040613, 669233895, 671162628 and 679353932, with source frame labels 18501-23500 and 488x488x5000 experimental clips. Keep all segmentation mean/SD, common-ROI trace mean/SD and runtime companions. Authenticated 1,563 manual ROIs are reference preparation, not complete movie-to-output execution.

permitted_observations.description: Use original motion-corrected experimental clips and declared permitted synthetic/development training and pretrained access. Final manual masks and imaging-derived reference traces are evaluator outputs, not candidate inputs. Disclose public reference exposure; paper+data and paper+data+author-code share all original clips/observations and differ only in supplied official code.

blocking_issues: Resolve physical 512-to-488 spatial crop origin, raw frame-label index base and complete native tiling/assembly/temporal boundary support before authentic movie-to-findings qualification.

Resolve source many-reference ROI matching collisions and the trace-reference discrepancy: released spatial Gaussian/bilateral processing versus paper temporal background removal and overlap correction. Preserve original common-detected-ROI population and imaging-derived ground-truth limitation; the original per-ROI versus per-video correlation reduction and SD convention remain unresolved and must not be inferred from segmentation macro-F1.

The authenticated released full checkpoint has eight outputs/396 trace samples versus paper N=15/P=9. This blocks claiming equivalence for that author replay route, not future independent AI implementations under resolved source observations/evaluation.

Require independently rerunnable candidate analysis, full-field masks for every source video, stable ROI identities/matches, complete per-video precision/recall/F1, reconstructed traces with source temporal support and per-reference correlations, and processing timings. Identity/empty ROI controls and copied published aggregates do not constitute computational reproduction.

Resolve reported SD conventions, numeric runtime reference/configuration and scientifically justified reproduction tolerances/uncertainty. Preserve the ten-video point estimand while accounting for eight actual donors; do not promote reported SD to a margin or assume ten independent mice.

Freeze authentic input/transformation/output-verifier identities, complete paired participant delivery, equal access/resource budgets and declared reference exposure. No qualified complete-panel author inference or AI run is established by the source-ROI preparation.
